cursor: witness_prefix={sequence,bytes,sha256,raw{stdout,stderr}}; confirmed/sequence/head properties read this single object
commit_order: prepare complete global and stream cursor object
disk_vs_memory: file is visible since exclusive open; no temp file/rename/second publication API. fsync confirmation and in-memory commit ACK are distinct phases; durable ACK visibility requires later valid receipt/external file observation.
failure_after_fsync_before_publication: raw persistence may lead committed witness cursor; pending WITNESS_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED, poison, no next append
failure_after_publication: published cursor retained, pending can say POST_COMMIT_ACCOUNTING_UNCONFIRMED; no rollback/relabel
decoder_checks: per-stream order/bytes/hash agree with receipt confirmed cursor
